statements.proposition: This change introduces no breaking changes to the existing API, and merged cases are only shown in listings when include_merged=true is passed.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Settled by reading the diff, not by running anything. Removed lines are only the short_id refactor (same output when case_number is present), a comment, and an import line widened. Response models gain only defaulted fields. list/search gain include_merged defaulting to False, which hides only cases that are merge secondaries, and none can exist before this change. New behaviour for merged cases (status edit raises) applies only to new data. Not exercised at runtime; tests could not be run (PR itself reports ModuleNotFoundError).
evidence: gh api pulls/1520/files: 7 files, 3 new (migration, test, schemas additions), 4 modified; no deletions of files

Diff removed lines (grep '^-'): only `from sqlalchemy.exc import ProgrammingError` (re-added widened), `short_id=f"CASE-{case.case_number:04d}"` x3 replaced by _format_short_id which returns the same string when case_number is not None, and one comment
models.py diff: only additions (merged_case_count=0, merged_into_case_id=None, is_merged=False, similar_cases/merged_cases default_factory=list, merged_into_case=None) plus new classes

router.py/service.py diff: list_cases, search_cases, list_cases_paginated gain `include_merged: bool = False`; filter applies `~exists().where(CaseMerge.merged_case_id == Case.id)` only when not include_merged
update_case raises only if the case has a CaseMerge parent (new table, empty before migration)
